Giga builds real-time AI agents for customer experience and enterprise automation, with a focus on voice superintelligence. The company is seeking early-career software engineers to help build the systems behind its AI agents, contributing across the backend with data pipelines, integrations, and agent infrastructure while owning projects and growing with experienced engineers.

Software

Responsibilities
Help build the systems that power our AI agents
Work across the backend, from data pipelines and integrations to agent infrastructure, shipping features alongside experienced engineers who will help you grow
Contribute to real problems from day one
Ramp up quickly
Take ownership of your work
Operate with increasing independence as you learn the codebase
Contribute to projects across our stack
Building features for our AI assistant: charts and alerts in Slack, natural language queries, and expanding Atlas to manage platform resources
Log visualization with filters, timestamps, and frequency charts to give visibility into agent behavior
Adding time-based knowledge (like ongoing incidents) that auto-updates from sources like status pages
Conversation awareness and recent interaction lookups so agents remember context across sessions
Be paired with senior engineers on larger initiatives while also owning smaller projects end-to-end as you ramp up

=============================
• Have 1-3 years of professional software engineering experience
• Are curious and ask good questions—you want to understand why things work, not just how
• Can take feedback well and iterate quickly
• Prefer shipping over perfection but still care about quality
• Want to grow at a startup where you'll have real responsibility early
